ms.promise: ADA Handle will utilize the concept of Merkle Trees for Decentralized Minting (DeMi). The purpose of the Merkle Tree is to allow on-chain minting of Handles, via a Smart Contract, while preventing double mints. This initial milestone will provide a proof of concept that we can indeed mint Handles via a Smart Contract and that the Smart Contract, utilizing Merkle Trees, will prevent a double mint.
ms.criteria: The acceptance criteria for this milestone is the ability to successfully mint Handles via the new Smart Contract while attempting to force a double mint. In other words, if we can mint multiple Handles and then attempt to mint the same set of Handles again, while the Smart Contract detects that those Handles had already been minted (via the Merkle Trees), we will have successfully demonstrated the concept.
ms.report:
This submission for Milestone 1 presents the completed work outlined in our project plan. The video deliverable demonstrates the progress and results achieved, showcasing the successful implementation and functionality of our decentralized minting solution.

Video Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EaiGEMgKPko

ms.promise: Following the work from Milestone 1, we not only need to able to mint Handles while preventing double mints via Smart Contracts, but we also need to import the existing subset of Handles that have already been minted into the Smart Contract so that the existing historical data is preserved and therefore the Smart Contract will start from the latest Handle minted with the existing private-key minting engine. Therefore, the desired output of this milestone is to demonstrate that we can indeed import the 230,000+ Handles that have already been minted (this number will change as we are still minting Handles every minute) into the Smart Contract, into the Merkle Tree, while preventing double mints for all of them.
ms.criteria: The acceptance criteria for this milestone will be the ability to successfully import all existing 230,000+ Handles into the Smart Contract and Merkle Trees, demonstrating that the Smart Contract successfully prevented a double mint for any of the existing 230,000 Handles. Via a script we will attempt to double mint 20% of all the on-chain Handles. This will all be executed within our Private TestNet.

ms.promise: As we approach the public launch of the Decentralized Minting (DeMi) via Smart Contracts and Merkle Trees, we will need to update the existing user experience within ADA Handle's minting portal (https://mint.handle.me), in order to make it compatible with the new DeMi engine. This will require us to work with our design team, while also testing the entire workflow to go from the time that users connect their wallets to the conclusion of the mint, once payment is made and received.
ms.criteria: The acceptance criteria for this milestone is a working layout for our minting portal that will accommodate the new requirements for the DeMi engine. The new layout must account for the interaction with the Smart Contract, detecting whether Handles are available when users are searching for them, the entire payment process to accept ADA, and confirm that the new Handle was correctly minted.

ms.promise:
The purpose of this milestone is to successfully deliver the Decentralized Minting (DeMi) engine on the Preview and PreProd public blockchains. This milestone will deliver the new user experience, the new Smart Contract to both Preview and PreProd. This will allow the community to fully test the solution and provide feedback on all the new features, as they will have full access to it from Preview and PreProd.
During this milestone we will also invest time with marketing and communications about the project.
ms.criteria:
The acceptance criteria for this milestone is the ability for anyone from the Cardano Community to successfully interact with the new DeMi Smart Contract on both Preview and PreProd. Handles will be minted from the new SC while the Merkle Trees will prevent double mints.
Another acceptance criteria for this milestone will be marketing and social-media efforts, in order to divulge the launch of our DeMi Engine.

Hello, Decentralized Minting for Preview and Preprod is now ready.
Both can be accessed by navigating to:
https://preview.handle.me and https://preprod.handle.me

The video below demonstrates how to use Decentralized Minting for both Preprod and Preview:
https://www.youtube.com/shorts/1EABlLBVSGc

To mint a DeMi Handle, navigate to https://preview.handle.me or https://preprod.handle.me, connect your wallet and search for a handle. Make sure your wallet is set to either Preview and Preprod.
After you've typed the Handle you want to mint, you will see two options, Normal Mint and DeMi (Beta). 
Click the DeMi (Beta) button and click "Mint Handle" to sign the transaction to purchase the Handle.
After submitting the transaction, an order is created.

The link below demonstrates the payment transaction for the Handle $demi-mint-01 in Preprod:
https://preprod.cardanoscan.io/transaction/08f19b685d0fb5161400ad495d0bd780bc81b2ff3b5f6f945a43520eb1edda8e

Our minting engine is looking for the order and when found, validates the information including price, datum, etc. Once we verify everything is accurate, we build a transaction using our Decentralized Smart Contracts to mint the Handle.

The link below demonstrates the mint transaction for the Handle $demi-mint-01 in Preprod:
https://preprod.cardanoscan.io/transaction/e061ec5d3a78f10bc0db4041827a47a1c56ce346d6abdd23afb112e19b97d154

ms.promise:
The purpose of this milestone is to migrate the Decentralized Minting (DeMi) engine to MainNet. During this phase we will invite the community to fully interact with the DeMi engine from MainNet.
During this phase we will also deliver the audit report for our Smart Contracts.
ms.criteria: The acceptance criteria for this milestone will be the ability for the community to utilize, in full, the DeMi engine on Cardano's MainNet. This will be our public launch. Therefore, provided that anyone can, in a permissionless manner, interact with the Smart Contract, mint Handles, attest that the mint was done correctly and that double mints are correctly prevented, we will have successfully concluded this milestone.

ms.promise:
The purpose of the final milestone is to make minor adjustments to the user experience, based on community feedback. We do not expect any major changes during this milestone as the majority of the work will have been done on the previous milestones. There is also a chance that nothing will be required during this milestone, given that the previous two milestones will have provided enough feedback and time to correct anything related to user experience.
We will also provide the community with documentation, available from https://docs.handle.me, explaining how they can interact with the DeMi Smart Contract and mint Handles in a decentralized manner. In other words, the community will be able to mint Handles independently from us, on-chain, and the documentation will explain this process.
ms.criteria: The acceptance criteria for this milestone is the attestation that the public portal to mint Handles on MainNet (https://mint.handle.me) is fully operational, in addition to proper documentation demonstrating how to mint Handles without our user portal.
